correctness.rationale: The even-shore code is the image of the even-weight vertex space under the incidence trace. A dependency among queried edges has degree-parity vector either zero or all ones. The zero case gives the cycle obstruction; on a forest the incidence image is exactly the vectors even on each component, so all ones belongs exactly when every component is even. Isolated vertices are included, and the n=2 empty-rank case agrees. A maximal support is a spanning forest, or it is obtained from one by removing a leaf edge when all original components are even. VC dimension is the rank; fixed basis queries attain that depth in a Littlestone tree and the number of concepts bounds depth above. The dual cycle space is the even-shore code, yielding the stated graft identification in its stated regime. The labeled SET formula counts forests by edges after removing all-even forests. Shellability gives a genuine wedge of top-dimensional spheres; reduced Euler characteristic gives (-1)^rank times the signed face sum, and the even-n rank is even.
